ghi_chu: Lô Ethopex 19/10/2026 bổ sung — phim thứ 10 thay 'Taming My Five Beast Stepsons' (không có QC gốc làm nguồn).

phim.nhan_vat: ELISA = pale dark-haired girl from the poster (half vampire); the LOCKHART TRIPLETS = three handsome brothers from the poster; AMBER = blonde rival

boi_canh.mo_ta: Rich gothic mansion with candlelit ballroom and grand staircase, moonlit misty forest, dark castle gate in the rain.

canh.loi: Three brothers promised me forever. Then they all chose her.
canh.anh: Candlelit ballroom: the three LOCKHART brothers turn their backs on ELISA in a white dress and walk toward blonde AMBER; ELISA holds a birthday cake, tears in her eyes.
canh.dong: The brothers walk away toward AMBER, ELISA's hands tremble, slow push-in on her face.

canh.loi: I'm half vampire. I wanted to be human, for them.
canh.anh: ELISA alone before an antique mirror, her reflection faint and translucent, her eyes flickering red for a moment.
canh.dong: Her reflection fades in and out, her eyes flash red, she touches the glass.

canh.loi: On my eighteenth birthday, they forgot me.
canh.anh: Party in the mansion: the triplets laugh and toast with AMBER while ELISA watches alone from the staircase holding an unopened gift.
canh.dong: Camera slides along the staircase; ELISA lowers the gift as they laugh.

canh.anh: Moonlit misty forest, ELISA in a torn white dress, fangs showing, eyes glowing red, wind whipping her hair.
canh.dong: ELISA lifts her head, her eyes ignite red, mist swirls around her.

canh.anh: ELISA in an elegant black gown at the top of the castle stairs, red eyes glowing, candles blowing out around her.
canh.dong: Candles snuff out one by one as ELISA descends, slow push-in.

canh.loi: Now the triplets are begging me to come back.
canh.anh: Rainy night at a gothic castle gate: the three brothers kneel in the rain, ELISA looks down at them coldly from the steps.
canh.dong: The brothers kneel in the rain, ELISA turns away, camera cranes up.
